name: label-commenter-config

schema.description: Configuration for Actions Label Commenter, for posting messages triggered by labels.

description:
The system is set up with a comment header of `## Automated Label Commenter` and a footer that reads:

```
---
*This comment was generated automatically.*
```

For the **bug** label, when it is applied to an issue the comment body will be “Thank you for reporting this bug. We will investigate.” The action taken is **add**, the issue will be **locked**, and the lock reason is “resolved.” If the bug label is later removed from the same issue, the comment will say “The bug label has been removed. If this is still an issue, please reapply.” The action in this case is **remove**, the issue will be **unlocked**, and there is no lock reason specified.

For the **enhancement** label, when it is added to a pull request the comment body will be “Thanks for proposing an enhancement! The team will review it soon.” The action is **add**, the pull request remains **unlocked**, and no lock reason is provided. When the enhancement label is removed from the pull request, the comment will read “The enhancement label was removed from this PR.” The action is **remove**, the pull request stays **unlocked**, and again there is no lock reason.

issue.body: Thank you for reporting this bug. We will investigate.
The bug label has been removed. If this is still an issue, please reapply.

pr.body: Thanks for proposing an enhancement! The team will review it soon.
The enhancement label was removed from this PR.
